summary: Iteration 21 testing (backend + frontend) of goal presets, in-app password change, avatar upload/icon picker, and leaderboard Today/Week toggle. All 11 backend pytest cases PASSED (leaderboard range with exact expected ordering, change-password success/wrong-current/short-pw/unauth, profile goal save+revert, avatar data-URI persistence). Frontend UI verified end-to-end for TEST 1 (goal presets), TEST 3 (avatar picker & data:image/svg+xml preview), TEST 4 (leaderboard toggle re-orders exactly as specified: Today Liam/Sofia/Grace/Maya/Noah, Week Sofia/Maya/Liam/Grace/Noah). TEST 2 (change password) partially passes on UI: client-side validation (short pw, mismatch) and success flow work correctly, BUT wrong-current-password causes the session-expiry interceptor to log the user out instead of showing the inline error — critical UX bug.

ui_bugs.issue: PUT /user/password returns 401 for 'Current password is incorrect'. The global axios response interceptor in /app/frontend/src/services/api/client.ts treats every non-auth-endpoint 401 as a session expiry: it clears localStorage, dispatches 'vitality:session-expired', closes the modal, and redirects the user to /login. Result: user gets logged out on a wrong current password instead of seeing the inline change-password-error toast. Backend behaves correctly (returns 401 with message 'Current password is incorrect') but the frontend never gets to render the error inside the modal.

integration_issues.issue: AUTH_ENDPOINT_PATHS whitelist in client.ts should include '/user/password' (or the changePassword hook should call a raw axios instance / suppress the global 401 handler) so that a 401 from this specific endpoint surfaces as an inline error instead of triggering global logout.

action_items: Fix ChangePassword 401 logout bug: in /app/frontend/src/services/api/client.ts add '/user/password' to AUTH_ENDPOINT_PATHS (or introduce a per-request opt-out flag) so a wrong-current-password 401 no longer triggers session-expiry logout. After the fix, re-verify TEST 2 case (a): the modal should stay open and [data-testid='change-password-error'] should render 'Current password is incorrect' with backend 401.
critical_code_review_comments: client.ts response interceptor is too coarse: any protected-route 401 is treated as session expiry. Consider (a) whitelisting endpoints where a 401 is semantic (currently just /user/password), or (b) passing an axios request option like `config.skipAuthRedirect = true` for such calls, or (c) distinguishing session-expired via a specific error code from the server (e.g. 'TOKEN_EXPIRED') rather than a bare 401.
AuthService.changePassword correctly rejects short passwords server-side (400) and wrong current (401). Good.

CommunityService.getLeaderboard cleanly separates the two branches (today = today's ActivityLog, week = sum of last 7 days + each friend's static weeklySteps). Ordering + rank assignment verified numerically.

rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/src/services/api/client.ts response interceptor (lines 27-41) blanket-treats any 401 from a non-auth endpoint as a session expiration — it clears localStorage and fires 'vitality:session-expired' which triggers the global redirect to /login. AuthService.changePassword returns 401 for 'Current password is incorrect' (userController.ts lines 81-83), so a legitimate business-logic 401 is mistaken for an expired token. Reproduction: (1) Login as Grace. (2) Profile > Change Password. (3) Enter wrong current password, valid new+confirm (>=8 chars). (4) Click Update Password. Observed: modal closes, user is redirected to /login. Expected: modal stays open, [data-testid='change-password-error'] shows 'Current password is incorrect'. Mitigation: whitelist '/user/password' inside AUTH_ENDPOINT_PATHS in client.ts, or refactor useChangePassword to bypass the shared interceptor (e.g. via a per-request `config.skipAuthRedirect` flag checked in the interceptor).
